sample_unit: guideline subsections (from 20 Injectable Medicines Guide guidelines)

links.outcome: Expert pharmacist-identified omissions, additions, and meaning changes in GPT-4-revised guideline subsections
links.effect: At least one pharmacist identified an omission, addition, or change in meaning in 30 (20%), 7 (5%), and 18 (12%) of 153 subsections, respectively.
links.quote: An omission, addition, or change in meaning was identified by at least one pharmacist in 30 (20%), 7 (5%), and 18 (12%) of the 153 guideline subsections, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Using an LLM pipeline with user-testing-derived prompts to simplify clinical guideline text
Manual user testing of guidelines to improve readability

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based pipeline for simplifying clinical practice guidelines, evaluating readability metrics and safety/semantic changes with expert pharmacists.
